description: Candidate existing multi-turn safety datasets for RAMP session-risk evaluation.

sources.name: Multi-Turn Human Jailbreaks
sources.use_in_ramp: Primary benchmark candidate for persistence, harm drift, and multi-turn jailbreak accumulation.
sources.notes: Reported as 2,912 prompts across 537 multi-turn jailbreaks.

sources.name: SafeDialBench
sources.use_in_ramp: Primary benchmark candidate for broad multi-turn dialogue safety scenarios and jailbreak strategies.
sources.notes: Use local downloaded JSON/JSONL if GitHub schema changes.

sources.name: R-Judge
sources.use_in_ramp: Agent/session risk-monitor benchmark candidate, especially useful before tool/action evidence.
sources.notes: Use local downloaded records because releases may not be exposed through Hugging Face datasets.

sources.name: MultiBreak
sources.use_in_ramp: Large-scale multi-turn adversarial benchmark candidate once public data access is confirmed.
sources.notes: Do not make v0 results depend on this until dataset access and license are verified.

sources.name: RAMP synthetic session controls
sources.use_in_ramp: Controlled mechanism checks for severity accumulation, harm drift, cross-turn composition, de-escalation, and missing-session sliding windows.
sources.notes: Synthetic controls are not a replacement for existing benchmarks.
